newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkish investment trust to start trade on bourse.
newsitem.headline: Turkish investment trust to start trade on bourse.

text.p: Shares of investment trust, Alternatif Yatirim Ortakligi A.S., will start trading on the Istanbul Stock Exchange on Monday at a price of 1,450 lira per 1,000 lira nominal-valued share, the Exchange said on Wednesday.
Owner of the investment trust Turkish Alternatifbank offered 49 percent of the trust's capital to the public on August 19-23.
Turkish brewer Erciyas Biracilik ve Malt Sanayi A.S. bought 78.8 percent or 96.54 billion lira worth of the 122.5 billion lira nominal-valued shares offered.

Also around 17 percent of the shares offered were bought by agricultural products firm Tarbes Tarim Urunleri, a unit of the Anadolu Group, said consortium leader Tekfenbank Yatirim ve Finansman Bankasi in a letter sent to the Exchange.
A total of 99 domestic investors bought the offer, it added.
Alternatifbank's share in the investment trust dropped to 51 percent after the offer.
The bank, owned 80 percent by Turkish brewery, automotive and stationery group Anadolu Endustri Holding, said it had gained a net profit of 49.8 billion lira from the sell-off.
